system.description:
Also, at 6th level, your medical knowledge extends beyond simple anatomy, you can see through the subtleties of body language, stress and chemical influence. You can speak in poisons and toxins and read people like an open scroll. You can use Medicine in place of Insight when using the See Through lies or Sense Motive skill actions.

If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with a creature, you can attempt to make a contested Medicine or Perception check vs the targets Deception. On a success, you becomes aware if they are suffering from a Condition or disease and one of the following;

If they are under the influence of chemical or drug.

Determine their Heritage.

Determine if the creatures Vulnerability, if any.
